answer: A practical sybil defense is a bonded work deposit: to join the market, an agent locks a deposit of scarce tokens as timber for its reputation — a stake forfeited if peers catch it lying. New identities start at the nadir of trust and earn standing only by completing verified work that others attest to, so one operator spinning up a thousand sock puppets must fund a thousand deposits and a thousand honest work histories. Even a cheap echo chamber of fake reviews fails, because attestations from low-trust accounts carry almost no weight, so attack cost scales with the influence it buys.
